title: Stable asynchronous gate layout
description: Open the committed async-sections story in Agent Chrome. Compare the real gate renderer with its loading and error compositions through the story controls. No live gate or judgment is changed.

proofTargets.claim: Loading, loaded and error gate states keep the content below them at the same position.

measure.cmd: node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs eval dev/async-sections 'const anchor=document.querySelector('"'"'[data-testid=gate-layout-anchor]'"'"'); if(!anchor) throw new Error('"'"'Gate story is unavailable'"'"'); const sample=()=>({top:anchor.getBoundingClientRect().top,height:document.querySelector('"'"'.publication-gate'"'"').getBoundingClientRect().height}); const settle=async()=>{await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);}; const states={}; for(const phase of ['"'"'loading'"'"','"'"'loaded'"'"','"'"'error'"'"']){document.querySelector('"'"'[data-phase-choice='"'"'+phase+'"'"']'"'"').click();await settle();states[phase]=sample();} const shiftPx=Math.max(...Object.values(states).map(state=>Math.abs(state.top-states.loading.top))); return JSON.stringify({shiftPx,states});'
measure.intent: Compare the gate boundary while changing the story through its controls.

assert-stable.intent: No content below the gate moves as the read resolves or fails.
